title: a ticket's BUILDME crossing is held until every ticket it declares a dependency on is PROVED and every measured BUILDME need carries a DONE mark
intention: inspect_entry gains a lane that reads a ticket's BUILDME `stage_needs` (a need may name a ticket id it waits on, or carry a measured mark) and, for a plan that has outcomes, its outcome `after` ticket ids, and holds the BUILDME crossing, naming every unmet one, until each named ticket is PROVED and each need carries a DONE mark.
why: Measured 2026-11-19: inspect_entry (cairn/tools/base/transitions.py:1045-1093) has six lanes (chart, intent, sorted, open questions, outcome claims, outline check) and none reads a dependency on another ticket. Outcome `after` accepts 12-hex ticket ids and is shape-checked at cast (plan_shape.py) but read by no gate; needs.py (ticket 43905593680a) keeps a per-stage need ledger with measured marks and no entry lane reads it. So 'BUILDME waits on X PROVED' written in a ticket's how text, as for 86cccb7d30f7 (waits on tester exec 21f9628872da and on akiendell pinned), holds nothing: a rule in prose (Law 4).
traces_to: Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy); Law 3 (a need's DONE is an observation with when and how_measured, needs.py); Law 8 (peers lean on a proved ticket, so a build waits for it).
how: A hypothesis, measured by the proof: a seventh lane the_ticket_waits_on_nothing_unproved in inspect_entry reads the ticket's state `stage_needs` BUILDME ledger, which both plan shapes can carry (decisions plans have no `after`): a need entry may carry an optional `ticket` (12-hex id) and is then met when that ticket's state reads PROVED; a need without `ticket` is met when its latest mark (needs.project_needs) is DONE. It also reads outcome `after` ticket ids where the plan has outcomes. An id that resolves to no ticket is held and named. One finding names every unmet dependency, with a mark's age. needs.py's door already accepts the extra `ticket` key (it validates `need` and `marks` only); the build records how a ticket's PROVED is read. Red-first proof under cairn/tools/base/proofs/ over scratch tickets of both plan shapes, one tooth per clause, PROVES declared.

clauses.claim: a DECISIONS-plan ticket whose BUILDME stage_needs names a ticket that is not PROVED is refused at the BUILDME entry, the finding naming that id
the same ticket crosses once the named ticket reads PROVED
a ticket with a BUILDME need carrying no `ticket` whose latest mark is not DONE, or that has no mark, is refused naming the need; a DONE mark with when and how_measured lets it cross
a named ticket id that resolves to no ticket, in a need or in an outcome `after`, is refused by name, not passed
an OUTCOMES-plan ticket whose outcome `after` names an unproved ticket is refused naming it, and crosses once it is PROVED
a ticket that declares no dependency crosses as before, and one refusal names every unmet dependency at once

decisions.text: D1: inspect_entry gains the lane the_ticket_waits_on_nothing_unproved beside its six, reading the state's BUILDME stage_needs (optional `ticket` key per need, else the latest mark) and outcome `after` ticket ids through needs.project_needs and plan.steps; the build records how a ticket's PROVED is read.
D2: the red-first proof builds scratch tickets and drives inspect_entry, one tooth per clause, PROVES declared.
D3: the lane-count assertion in test_transitions.py moves 6→7 and its passed count 5→6, because the seventh lane joins inspect_entry's record; the change is the count and nothing else.

out: cairn/tools/base/needs.py (the ledger and its mark door are unchanged)
whether a mark ever expires (an open edge of 43905593680a)
declaring 86cccb7d30f7's waits as BUILDME stage_needs (its own re-plan once this is proved; its plan stays a decisions plan)

measured.saw: of 484 tickets in the commons, the 260 not at PROVED carry: 173 outcomes plans, 46 decisions plans, 41 neither; the 46 are 18% of open plans with a shape, so a lane reading only outcome `after` cannot hold them. `dependencies` is a declared state field but is prose in 148 tickets, not ids, so it is not reused; `stage_needs` is a declared state field both shapes can carry (20 tickets use it) and needs.py's door accepts an extra key per need
measured.how: python over CairnCommons/tickets/*.json and *.state.json (workflow_and_state without a [PROVED cursor = open; outcomes vs decisions key), grep of cairn/ for readers of `dependencies`, read of cairn/tools/base/needs.py:144-165

measured.saw: inspect_entry composes six lanes, none reading a dependency on another ticket; plan_shape accepts `after` ticket ids and plan.steps returns them, read by no gate
